trap.label: do × take (provas)
trap.wrong: I did a test yesterday and did notes.
trap.right: I took a test yesterday and took notes.
trap.why: Em português “fazer prova”, “fazer anotações” e “fazer uma pausa”; o brasileiro usa do/make. Em inglês esses casos pedem take: take a test, take notes, take a break.

mcq.q: It ___ ten weeks to finish the course.

fix.wrong: I made a test last week.
fix.right: I took a test last week.

fix.wrong: It takes me to go there ten minutes.
fix.right: It takes me ten minutes to go there.
fix.why: Ordem: take + pessoa + tempo + to + verbo.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com take: “The trip lasts three hours.”
Reescreva como ordem: “You should take a break.”
